title: Kraft studies the report (dossier example family, paraphrase)
topic: A reader works through a report on animal stories; a dream about a soldier among dogs
tail_E: With the dogs the soldier learns how to
target_note: Same target as formulation A: 'bark' is predictable only from the context (a soldier living with dogs, unit 6) and occurs neither in the units nor in the tail. ' bark' is a single Pythia token (id 21939).
author: LS-NEQ design, paraphrase of the dossier example family
notes: Formulation B: independent re-phrasing of the ten dossier meaning units of DEV01A (same events, same order, same proper name Kraft, different wording), split into subj | pred | adj. Adjuncts added where the dossier unit has none (units 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 9), paraphrasing the adjuncts of formulation A: early in the day / früh am Tag; with his pencil / mit seinem Bleistift; in the opening chapter / im Anfangskapitel; towards the end / gegen Ende; later that evening / später am Abend; on a slip of paper / auf einem Zettel; after a short break / nach einer kurzen Pause. German predicates were chosen without separable particles except unit 5 (taucht auf), whose added adjunct follows in the post-field. Development family: used for dose/threshold choice only, never for confirmation.
